svg.aria-label: Provider mode in one page: Rust exports become a shared object the Tile compiler loads; it asks per call site which implementations exist and once for their code

text.style: font: 600 17px var(--sans); fill: var(--fg); white-space: pre

svg.text: Provider mode: a tile library that answers the Tile compiler while the kernel compiles

text.style: font: 400 12.5px var(--sans); fill: var(--muted); white-space: pre

svg.text: For exports without tile_shape. The compiler asks for one implementation symbol per tile size; the provider builds it from one Rust body.

svg.text: Tile IR declarations can be parametric, but code never is: each tile size links its own symbol. A static library must ship those symbols ahead of time (tile_shape).

text.style: font: 400 11.5px var(--sans); fill: var(--fg); white-space: pre

svg.text: The provider is asked for them while the kernel compiles, so one Rust body serves every size.
